steps.content: Your fingers close around the haft of the blood-stained hoe.
The moment you touch it, the world drowns in crimson.
A foreign will floods your nerves, and you are now a passenger in your own body. You watch as your legs carry you toward Hilda, your hand raising the hoe against her.

In that final second, you are no longer yourself. You are Shane. You are every vengeful villager. You are the pure, distilled essence of their rage and resentment. As if a thousand hands guide your own, the hoe falls. A bloody mist fills the air.
She does not speak. She does not cry out. She simply closes her eyes, a silent acceptance of the fate you deliver.
The blood is shockingly warm and sticky on your face.
When you come back to your senses, the vision shatters. Hilda and the mob are gone. Nothing remains but the phantom echo of their cheers, roaring in your ears.
